Subject: SOC2 type II + interim attestation for EU processing

Hi Rafael,

We are in the final stage of our supplier security review for a new pilot and need a few items before we can sign off:

- A copy of your latest SOC 2 Type II report (or a redacted copy) covering the most recent audit period.
- If there is an audit gap between the last report and the next scheduled report, can you provide an interim attestation / bridge letter that confirms controls in place during the gap and the exact covered dates?
- Clarify hosting: for EU/UK customers, is production inference and storage guaranteed to remain in an EU region? If not, please explain the control plane vs data plane separation and whether any customer data traverses the US.
- Evidence exports: we will need key items that the auditor expects — KMS tenancy and key rotation statements, access audit log sample (redacted), and a high-level data flow diagram showing where tokens and logs live.
- Any contractual addenda you offer for cross-border transfers (DPA wording, SCCs, or similar).

Target timeline: can you provide the items above within 7 business days? Our security and legal teams need to clear this before our procurement team issues PO.

Thanks,
Lucie
Lucie Moreau
Head of Vendor Risk — Eurofin Bank

Hi Lucie — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (security) and Grace (solutions) to handle evidence and technical diagrams. High-level answers below; we will follow up with artifacts and a short call slot.

Short answers:
- SOC 2 Type II: We have a Type II report covering 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30. We can provide a redacted PDF for vendor review.
- Interim attestation / bridge letter: We will provide a signed interim attestation that covers the gap between that report and our next issuance if there is any overlap your auditors flag. Draft attached for your review.
- Hosting & data residency: For hosted customers, we operate a regional data plane; EU customers can request EU-first processing and storage. Control plane (orchestration/management APIs) is run from our control plane endpoints (US-based) by default — we isolate customer data and do not route payloads through the control plane for inference results, but some metadata (billing/usage telemetry) may be aggregated outside the EU. Dedicated and Private deployments can be fully EU-resident.
- Evidence exports: we can produce: redacted SOC 2, signed interim attestation, KMS tenancy statement, sample audit log extract (redacted), and a concise data flow diagram.
- Contractual addenda: we offer a DPA with SCCs and will provide standard language for review; for enterprise customers we can discuss Northern-Ireland/UK addendum variations if required.

Can we set a 30-minute call on Monday (6/8) to go over the artifacts and confirm the exact list your auditors need? I will send an invite pending your availability.

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Thanks for the quick reply and the draft attestation. A few clarifying questions so our audit team can map controls:

1) "Redacted SOC 2" — can you confirm the report scope (systems/services included) and whether it explicitly lists geographic boundaries for data processing?
2) The interim attestation - would that be signed by your VP Security/Compliance? We need an organisationally-authoritative signature.

If you can answer 1-5 and share the artifacts you referenced, we can triage and close on procurement.

Hi Lucie — thanks for the detailed questions. I am Marissa (Head of Security & Compliance); below are concrete answers and what we will deliver this week.

1) SOC 2 scope: our report covers Redwood Inference hosted services (text generation, chat, embeddings) and related telemetry/ingestion pipelines used by the hosted product. The report's description of systems lists the regions eligible for customer data storage; we will include the exact scope page in the redacted PDF we send.

2) Interim attestation: yes — the interim attestation / bridge letter will be signed by our VP of Security & Compliance (organisationally-authoritative) and will explicitly state the covered dates and controls that remain in effect. Draft attached; final signed copy will be provided as a PDF.

3) KMS: by default in Hosted we use Redwood-managed KMS with tenancy separation (logical isolation per tenant). We offer a customer-managed KMS option for Dedicated/Private deployments; for Hosted EU-first customers we can provide regional KMS tenancy where keys do not leave the EU for encryption at rest. Rotation cadence: 90 days for service keys; customer-managed keys follow customer KMS policy.

4) Audit logs: we will provide a 30-day sample (redacted PII) containing admin actions and key operations with timestamps and role-based actor names (e.g., redacted_admin_01). This will be an exportable CSV / PDF and will include a short legend explaining fields.

5) DPA / SCCs: our standard DPA includes the latest EU SCCs by default; for UK customers we can provide the UK Addendum. For enterprise deals we also support bespoke amendments where required.

Artifacts we will share within 3 business days (links + attachments):
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (report scope page included)
- Signed interim attestation / bridge letter (VP-signed)
- KMS tenancy statement and configuration notes
- 30-day redacted audit log sample
- Updated DPA with SCC language (track changes enabled)
- High-level data flow diagram (PNG)

Next steps: I will upload these to a secure folder and send a DocuSign for the final attestation signature. Rafael / Grace will set a 30-minute walk-through with your audit team — proposed slots attached.

If there are any narrow split-scope questions (e.g., processing for EU customers in hosted vs dedicated), call out the account type and we will provide configuration-specific evidence.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
